newsitem.title: USA: FedEx says Q4 US package volumes up 10 pct.
newsitem.headline: FedEx says Q4 US package volumes up 10 pct.

text.p: Federal Express Corp said Monday its package volume in the U.S. rose 10 percent year-over-year in the fourth quarter.
The company said its total average daily express volume was 2.8 billion compared to 2.5 billion for the same period a year ago.
The company said this volume growth was accompanied by a 1.1 percent rise in underlying revenue per package.
At the same time, U.S. cost per package rose 2.4 percent, primarily due to increased fuel and contract trucking expenses.
The company reported earnings per share for the quarter of $1.14 compared to $1.01 for the same period a year ago.
